sn45.25:2.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the superior person?
sn45.25:2.2: Here someone is of right view … right concentration.
sn45.25:2.3: This is called the superior person. “And what, bhikkhus, is the one who is better than the superior person? Here someone is of right view … right concentration, right knowledge, right liberation. This is called the one who is better than the superior person.”
